text: Misal sirkooɓe jogitiiɓe gaanin Alla ɓen sanamuuji reweteeɗi, jortagol nafa e tefoore majji, ko wano misal marijaawowal saccungal suudu ka daɗndira jaggitere. Ko ɓuri non lo'ude e cuuɗi ɗin, ko suudu marijaawo; tawde ndu dartotaako gaño. Ko non sanamuuji maɓɓe ɗin kadi wa'i, ko nafataa, ɗi lorrataa, ɗi tefataa. Kono ko si sirkooɓe ɓen anndayno ɗum, si ɓe aɗitoo jogitorgol sanamuuji ɗin, reweteeɗi gaanin Alla.
